cloze.text: The ___ is a feeding level in a food chain or web: producers are the first level, herbivores the second, and carnivores the levels above, and the ___ is a sequence of trophic levels showing who eats whom, with arrows pointing in the direction of energy flow, from food to feeder.

___ is an organism, usually a green plant, that captures sunlight by photosynthesis and feeds the whole food chain or web, while ___ is an organism that obtains energy by eating other organisms: primary consumers eat producers, secondary consumers eat herbivores.

frames: ___ is a feeding level in a food chain or web: producers are the first level, herbivores the second, and carnivores the levels above.
___ is a sequence of trophic levels showing who eats whom, with arrows pointing in the direction of energy flow, from food to feeder.
___ is all the interlinked food chains in a community, showing every feeding pathway energy can take.
starters: Trophic level is a feeding level in a food chain or web: producers are the first level, herbivores the second, and carnivores the levels above....
Food chain is a sequence of trophic levels showing who eats whom, with arrows pointing in the direction of energy flow, from food to feeder....
Food web is all the interlinked food chains in a community, showing every feeding pathway energy can take....

wordBank.gloss: A feeding level in a food chain or web: producers are the first level, herbivores the second, and carnivores the levels above.
A sequence of trophic levels showing who eats whom, with arrows pointing in the direction of energy flow, from food to feeder.
All the interlinked food chains in a community, showing every feeding pathway energy can take.
A diagram of the energy at each trophic level, narrowing upwards because only about 10% of energy moves up each level.
An organism, usually a green plant, that captures sunlight by photosynthesis and feeds the whole food chain or web.
An organism that obtains energy by eating other organisms: primary consumers eat producers, secondary consumers eat herbivores.
An organism that breaks down dead matter and waste, releasing carbon and other matter back into cycles.
The cycling of carbon between air, living organisms and decomposers: photosynthesis draws CO2 in, respiration and combustion return it.
